# inilite 0.3.2 (vendored reference copy)

A reference copy of the `inilite` package, the dependency confkit used to rely on. It is kept here for reading only. Do not modify it and do not import it from application code (`confkit/`); see LICENSE.

Its dialect is not the confkit format: it has no dotted keys, no includes and no typed values, and its errors carry no line numbers. `docs/FORMAT.md` is the contract for confkit.
